{{recipe}} 

Herb-grilled steak brushed with olive oil and butter and cooked to perfect medium rare with roast potatoes and sautéed peppers rivals even the best steakhouse. 

== Ingredients ==

=== '''Steak''' ===
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (24–32 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Beef|strip steaks]]
* 1 ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]], finely chopped
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* Extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided

=== '''Potatoes''' ===
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] redskin [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], cut into 2-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] cubes but left unpeeled
* 1 tbsp salt
* 1 tbsp black pepper
* ¾ cup olive oil
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 1 ½ tsp dried rosemary
* 1 tbsp dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]

=== '''Peppers''' ===
* 4 assorted [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] into 3-inch strips
* 1 tbsp olive oil
* Salt
* Freshly-ground black pepper
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] red [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]]

=== Other ===
* Few glasses red wine or [[Cookbook:Cognac|cognac]]
* Nice [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]] for an appetizer (hopefully with a homemade dressing)

== Procedure ==
#Set up a charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] for direct and indirect heat.
#Heat a large pot of water to a rolling [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Add potatoes and cook for 10 minutes.
#Shock potatoes in a bowl of ice water, drain, and pat very dry with [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towels]].
#Place potatoes on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]] and let dry for 2 hours.
#Combine remaining roast potatoes ingredients in a large stainless steel bowl. Add dry potatoes and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to coat.
#Place potatoes on a 13x9-inch [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]] and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 450°F for 25 minutes.
#Meanwhile, prepare the steaks: [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] steaks with extra-virgin olive oil. Sprinkle with salt and freshly ground black pepper and rub herbs into flesh.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] steaks, covered, over direct heat, for 1¼ minutes, then rotate 90° and cook for another 1¼ minutes. Flip and repeat 1 more time.
#Move steaks to indirect heat and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 143°F for medium rare.
#Remove to serving platters and top each with 1 tablespoon of the butter. Keep warm in a 200°F oven.
#Meanwhile, heat a 10-inch straight-sided [[Cookbook:Sauté Pan|sauté pan]] over medium-high heat. Add oil and peppers to pan and cook, shaking the pan often, 8 minutes. Remove to serving platters.
#Place potatoes on serving platters. [[Cookbook:Garnish|Garnish]] with sprigs of rosemary, if desired. Serve.

steps.text: Set up a charcoal grill for direct and indirect heat.
Heat a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add potatoes and cook for 10 minutes.
Shock potatoes in a bowl of ice water, drain, and pat very dry with paper towels.
Place potatoes on a cooling rack and let dry for 2 hours.
Combine remaining roast potatoes ingredients in a large stainless steel bowl. Add dry potatoes and toss to coat.
Place potatoes on a 13x9-inch baking pan and bake at 450°F for 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare the steaks: Brush steaks with extra-virgin olive oil. Sprinkle with salt and freshly ground black pepper and rub herbs into flesh.
Grill steaks, covered, over direct heat, for 1¼ minutes, then rotate 90° and cook for another 1¼ minutes. Flip and repeat 1 more time.
Move steaks to indirect heat and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 143°F for medium rare.
Remove to serving platters and top each with 1 tablespoon of the butter. Keep warm in a 200°F oven.
Meanwhile, heat a 10-inch straight-sided sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add oil and peppers to pan and cook, shaking the pan often, 8 minutes. Remove to serving platters.
Place potatoes on serving platters. Garnish with sprigs of rosemary, if desired. Serve.
